# Connectome_Verification_Protocol

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A systematic procedure to validate that simulation inputs are derived from real biological connectome data rather than random parameter generation. Ensures experimental results in iNEST simulations have scientific credibility and can be compared against biological ground truth.
